learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the basic concepts of fluid mechanisms: hydraulic mechanism, pneumatic mechanisms, hydraulic and pneumatic circuit.
Become familiar with the composition of hydraulic and pneumatic circuits, basic hydraulic and pneumatic components, their functions, structures, characteristics using the circuit.
Students will learn to count instances hydraulic and pneumatic circuits in steady state and solve the starting and braking hydraulic actuators.
Learn to design simple hydraulic and pneumatic circuits and compile them on trainer in the laboratory.
Students acquire basic knowledge of the operation, maintenance, measurement and diagnostics of hydraulic and pneumatic equipment.

syllabus_topics: Fluid mechanism, fluid drive, fluid circuit.
Hydraulic and pneumatic circuits: composition, graphical symbols of elements, functional circuit diagrams. Basic hydraulic and pneumatic circuits.
Working fluids of hydraulic circuits: properties, types, applications. Compressed air and its properties.
Pressure energy sources - hydraulic pumps: design, function, parameters, characteristics, control.
Rotary hydraulic motors and actuators: construction, functions, parameters.
Hydraulic cylinders: design, function, parameters.
Flow direction control elements: directional valves, check valves, pilot operated check valves.
Flow size control elements: throttle valves, flow control valves, orifices, and throttles.
Pressure control valves: pressure relief and reducing valves.
Proportional control technology, applications of proportional control technology.
Fundamentals of servo engineering and its applications.
Accessories for hydraulic and pneumatic circuits: accumulators, filters, pipes, hoses, tanks, coolers, etc.
Introduction to pneumatic mechanisms.
Basics of hydromechanics - Pascal´s law, Law for pressure propagation, Equation of continuity, laminar and turbulent flow, major(local) and minor pressure drops, Bernoulli´s equation.
Fluid mechanisms - advantages, disadvantages, applications.
Fluid mechanisms - energy transfer (principle), basic principle of hydraulic systems (figure and description).
Fluids in systems - their purpose in systems, types, applications.
Hydrostatic converters - types, purpose, ideal converters (equations).
Hydrostatic converters - real converters (equations), efficiencies.
Basic characteristics of real rotary converters.
Rotary hydraulic pumps - types, basic principles, advantages, and disadvantages.
Rotary hydraulic motors - types, basic principles, advantages, and disadvantages.
Rotary actuators - types, basic principles, advantages, and disadvantages.
Hydraulic cylinders - types, basic principles, advantages, and disadvantages.
Check valves, shut-off valves, cartridge valves - types, basic principles, applications, graphical symbols.
Directional valves - types, basic principles, applications, graphical symbols.
Throttle valves - types, flow equation, basic principles, applications, graphical symbols, characteristics.
2-way and 3-way flow control valves - their purpose, basic principles, applications.
Pressure control valves - types, basic principles, applications, graphical symbols.
Accumulators - types, basic principles, advantages, and disadvantages.
Accumulators - their functions in systems, examples of their applications in hydraulic systems (figures).
Filters and filtration technology - filter types, purpose, location in systems.
Tanks - purposes, types, heat flow, stabilization circuit (temperature, filtration).
Heat exchangers - types, power equations.
Pressure intensifiers - their purpose in systems, types, applications, pressure gain.
Electrohydraulic components in hydraulic systems - purpose, function, types, characteristics.
Basics of pneumatic mechanisms.
